comparison.objective: Simultaneously release two lid latches, lift the lid, and set it aside; candidate extracts one terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Symmetric bimanual tab translation and lid lifting versus housing orientation, wire deflection, recessed single-blade insertion, and coordinated pull.
comparison.success_condition: Both latches released and lid removed/stably placed without moving the case; candidate requires intact selective terminal extraction, with force/damage thresholds missing.
comparison.reason: Latch release is a shared primitive, but simultaneous external tabs do not test tool-mediated recessed depinning.
